name: Dendrite Starblaze
summary: In Nighthaven, Dendrite Starblaze guides druids who come to Moonglade. As a Cenarion Circle mentor, he welcomes night elf and tauren apprentices. Through him they are summoned to the holy grove to master its rites, from cleansing toxins to communing with nature's forms.

sections.title: A Guide in the Sacred Haven
sections.body: When novice druids learn Teleport: Moonglade, Dendrite is among the first to greet them in Nighthaven. He follows the Cenarion Circle's calling beyond the Alliance and Horde. Night elf and tauren druids alike find kinship beneath the haven's boughs, where Kaldorei tradition meets the tauren path.

sections.title: Trials of the Wild
sections.body: Dendrite guides apprentices into nature's deeper ways. He sends them to examine tainted waters and seek herbs that can cure poison and pestilence. Then he oversees the water trials, testing their patience and endurance beneath the surface before he grants them communion with aquatic forms.

faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze is a night elf druid and Cenarion Circle mentor in Nighthaven, within Moonglade. He guides developing druids through essential rites and training.

faq.q: Why does a night elf train Horde tauren?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle keeps beyond the Alliance and Horde's political divisions. In Moonglade, night elves and tauren practice druidic arts together under ancient oaths of brotherhood, leaving worldly conflicts beyond the mountain passes.

faq.q: What quests does Dendrite Starblaze offer?
faq.answer: Dendrite guides druids through trials in curing venom and disease, then toward the communion required for aquatic form.

faq.q: Where can Dendrite Starblaze be found?
faq.answer: Dendrite can be found in Nighthaven, on the northern shores of Lake Elune'ara in Moonglade.

faq.q: How do young druids reach Dendrite for the first time?
faq.answer: Racial trainers teach novice druids Teleport: Moonglade around their tenth circle of training. The spell carries them straight to Moonglade, where Dendrite awaits.

faq.q: Can non-druid adventurers interact with him?
faq.answer: Non-druids may visit Nighthaven and speak with Dendrite. He offers no training, trials or tasks to those outside the Cenarion Circle's druidic traditions.

angles.text: When you first teleport to Moonglade, Dendrite guides you in curing sickness and seeking communion with aquatic forms.
As a Shu'halo druid from Mulgore, you can see in Dendrite how the Cenarion Circle's bond reaches beyond the feud between Horde and Alliance.
As a Kaldorei initiate, you meet Dendrite at Nighthaven, where he keeps the classical rites of nature stewardship and welcomes you into the Cenarion order.
